properties.description:
The increment that fixed a defect this project shipped the same week and had itself predicted-then-shelved, and that gave a user's private translator a home in the design.

Pinned here because a release needs a position on the time axis: without AT_EPOCH a release resolves to a point with no sequence, so any window computed from it loses its lower bound.
properties.name: v0.56.0 cut — the guard asks the store, and a node records the user's own word
